scope: Nominal bead envelopes of emitted outer walls at two flat-bearing X sections on both wings, across central 28 mm of their assembled Z span. Excludes physical bead distortion and slot end/corner transitions.
method: At each eligible model layer, intersect nominal emitted outer-wall bead buffers (half declared line width) with Y-directed lines at X=±(104.53/2+1.55) and X=±(104.53/2+2.0). X180 placement gives plate X=162.5+CAD X, plate Y=159.88-CAD Y and layer Z=23-CAD Z. Report the facing floor and roof edges across |CAD Z|<=14.
